frozen_at: before any outcome analysis of the 900-question corpus (collection mid-flight)
split: task-level grouped 5-fold CV; extraction and reasoning of the same task always share a fold; no node-level splitting

definitions.Q_node: node-level EXEC correctness: extraction = parse + required-operand coverage; reasoning = expression executed on the facts it consumed matches gold (close, 1e-4 rel)
definitions.Q_task: task-level final value matches gold on the same consumed facts
definitions.C: total tokens (input+output) per call; routing rows sum over the task's calls
definitions.L: local vLLM service latency per call (single local GPU; NOT cross-hardware comparable)
definitions.regret_primary: R_Q = Q_oracle - Q_selected at task level; multi-objective regret reported separately, never mixed into the main table

layer1_per_model_prediction.reporting: per model (medium/large/coder) x node type (extraction/reasoning); pooled numbers secondary

layer2_ranking: pairwise ranking accuracy (per question, all model pairs)

arms: Query Router (retrained, same folds, no type conditioning)
Type Prior (per-type best by train folds)

cross_domain.not_comparable: absolute quality (mh reasoning consumes own extraction; tq legacy measurements are gold-facts conditional) - protocol difference must be stated

interpretation_precommitment: If Capability Router does not significantly exceed Type Prior, that is an acceptable outcome: the question is how much predictable information the capability profile carries and how much converts to routing gains, not that a learned router must win.
